mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls growth above 0.3 percentage points signals stronger household income and consumption, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the Housing Starts Index exceeding 5% signals weakening residential investment and consumer confidence, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in the Industrial Production Index above 0.5% signals stronger manufacturing activity and earnings growth, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressure and input costs, which reduces corporate margins and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in Real Personal Income above 1% signals weakening consumer purchasing power, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls growth above 0.3 percentage points combined with a decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a synchronized labor market tightening, which increases wage pressure and input costs, reducing corporate margins and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 0.3pp AND UNRATE < 4.0% over 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).
